es: Deducir el escenario alternativo en textos con condicionales de tercer tipo, mixtos, but for y otherwise, distinguiendo lo real de lo imaginado.

teaching.en: If the hikers hadn't taken a compass, they would have been lost in the fog.
teaching.es: Si los excursionistas no hubieran llevado una brújula, se habrían perdido en la niebla.
teaching.explanationEs: Tercer condicional: lo que se niega es real (llevaban brújula) y lo que se imagina es el desenlace alternativo.
segments: If the hikers hadn't taken a compass, they
would have been lost in the fog.
teaching.audioText: If the hikers hadn't taken a compass, they would have been lost in the fog.

teaching.en: If she hadn't called the helicopter, she wouldn't be alive today.
teaching.es: Si no hubiera llamado al helicóptero, hoy no estaría viva.
teaching.explanationEs: Condicional mixto: causa pasada (had + participio) y efecto presente (would + verbo).
segments: If she hadn't called the helicopter,
teaching.audioText: If she hadn't called the helicopter, she wouldn't be alive today.

teaching.en: If he weren't so unaware of the danger, he wouldn't have gone alone.
teaching.es: Si no fuera tan inconsciente del peligro, no habría ido solo.
teaching.explanationEs: Condicional mixto inverso: un rasgo actual (pasado simple) explica un hecho pasado (would have + participio).
segments: If he weren't so unaware of the
danger, he wouldn't have gone alone.
teaching.audioText: If he weren't so unaware of the danger, he wouldn't have gone alone.

teaching.en: But for the fog, the helicopter would have reached them in an hour.
teaching.es: De no ser por la niebla, el helicóptero los habría alcanzado en una hora.
teaching.explanationEs: But for + nombre señala el obstáculo real: la niebla sí existió y retrasó el rescate.
segments: But for the fog, the helicopter would
have reached them in an hour.
teaching.audioText: But for the fog, the helicopter would have reached them in an hour.

teaching.en: The alarm woke us; otherwise, the fire would have been a disaster.
teaching.es: La alarma nos despertó; de lo contrario, el incendio habría sido un desastre.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise resume toda la condición contraria: equivale a «si la alarma no nos hubiera despertado».
segments: The alarm woke us; otherwise, the
fire would have been a disaster.
teaching.audioText: The alarm woke us; otherwise, the fire would have been a disaster.

teaching.en: We narrowly escaped the flood; had we left later, the outcome would have been very different.
teaching.es: Escapamos por poco de la inundación; de haber salido más tarde, el resultado habría sido muy distinto.
teaching.explanationEs: Narrowly significa «por poco»; la inversión con had introduce el escenario que no ocurrió.
segments: We narrowly escaped the flood; had we left
later, the outcome would have been very different.
teaching.audioText: We narrowly escaped the flood; had we left later, the outcome would have been very different.

prompt.es: ¿Qué ocurrió de verdad, según el texto?

choices.text: They forgot the compass and walked in circles.
They took a compass, so they did not walk in circles.
They took a compass but still got lost.

feedback.es: If they hadn't taken… niega un hecho real: sí llevaron la brújula y por eso no se perdieron.

hint.es: Una condición negativa irreal señala un hecho real afirmativo.

origin.text: If the hikers hadn't taken a compass, they would have walked in circles in the fog.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no hubiera llamado al helicóptero, hoy no estaría viva.»

feedback.es: El efecto es actual (hoy), así que va would + verbo base: condicional mixto.

hint.es: Hoy es presente: efecto actual con would + verbo base.

origin.text: If she hadn't called the helicopter, she ___ alive today.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La alarma nos despertó; de lo contrario, habría sido un desastre.»

answer.text: The alarm woke us otherwise it would have been a disaster

feedback.es: Otherwise abre la consecuencia imaginada, que lleva would have + participio.

hint.es: Otherwise va antes de la consecuencia y esta termina con a disaster.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué habría pasado si no se hubieran marchado a tiempo.

choices.text: They would have reached the storm later.
Their tents would have been flooded.

feedback.es: Otherwise equivale a «si no nos hubiéramos ido»: las tiendas habrían quedado bajo el agua.

origin.audio: We left the campsite just before the storm. Otherwise, our tents would have been under water.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo despertar a la persona.

choices.text: A phone call woke her up.
An alarm clock woke her up.

feedback.es: If the phone hadn't rung implica que sí sonó: la llamada la despertó y por eso está en la cafetería.

origin.audio: If the phone hadn't rung, I wouldn't be sitting in this café with you now. I would still be asleep at home.

choices.text: The wind did not change, so they landed in the wrong city.
The wind changed, so they landed in the right city.
The wind changed and they landed in the wrong city.

feedback.es: Had the wind not changed… niega un hecho real: el viento cambió y por eso aterrizaron en la ciudad correcta.

origin.text: The pilot said: «Had the wind not changed, we would have landed in the wrong city. We were lucky.»

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si hubiéramos comprado las entradas, ahora estaríamos en la playa.»

answer.text: If we had bought the tickets we would be on the beach now

feedback.es: Mixto: if + had + participio para la causa pasada y would + verbo para el efecto actual.

prompt.es: Completa: «Sin tu ayuda, no habría aprobado el examen.»

feedback.es: Without + nombre sustituye a una condición y la consecuencia pasada lleva would not have + participio.

origin.text: Without your help, I ___ passed the exam.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que lo expresa con but for.

choices.text: But for the rain, they will play the match.
But for it rained, they would have played the match.
But for the rain, they would have played the match.

feedback.es: But for + nombre señala el obstáculo real (la lluvia) y el efecto pasado lleva would have + participio.

origin.text: Llovió mucho durante el partido y lo suspendieron.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ahora viviría fuera» y «no la habría pedido» (mixtos).

feedback.es: Primero: causa pasada y efecto presente (would + verbo). Segundo: rasgo actual y efecto pasado (would not have + participio).

sentences: If I had won the scholarship, I ___ abroad now.
If she weren't so ambitious, she ___ applied for it.
